children: , climbed 7.32% to $265.19 around 11.54 a.m. EST on October 19, following Bernstein's upgrade. According to Investing.com, the firm raised its rating from Market Perform to Outperform and lifted its price target from $237 to $350, citing stronger AI tailwinds. That gives investors a more ambitious valuation target. Delivering the growth to support it is Datadog's next job.

The business has momentum. Datadog's second-quarter results showed revenue rising 36% to $1.12 billion, while customers generating at least $100,000 in annual recurring revenue increased roughly 23% to 4,720. Sales outpacing growth in that customer group puts spending expansion firmly in focus, although those figures alone cannot establish how much existing customers increased their purchases. Bits Agent Builder, which lets customers create custom AI agents, adds another product to watch as Datadog pushes deeper into AI.

The valuation leaves less room for disappointment: the GF Value comparison puts the shares 28.21% above its $206.84 estimate. That premium makes the next earnings report a meaningful checkpoint. Datadog's third-quarter guidance calls for revenue of $1.135 billion$1.145 billion and non-GAAP operating income of $260 million$270 million, implying a roughly 23.2% operating margin at the midpoints. The upgrade lifts expectations. Revenue growth and profitability now need to carry the argument.

title: Datadog Stocks Rise 7.32% as Bernstein's $350 Target Raises the Earnings Stakes
